title: The Best Cardigans of 2026 — A Verdict for Every Body and Budget
headline: One Pinterest-girl staple, one French-girl staple, one classic American staple. Pick the one for you.
lede: The cardigan is having its longest moment in modern fashion — five years and counting. The three we've fully verdicted span the entire conversation: an oversized Pinterest-saturated piece, a true-to-size French restraint piece, and a classic-fit American piece on a reliable sale cycle. The right one depends almost entirely on what you mean by 'cardigan.'

entries.best_for: If you wear oversized as a default and your bottoms run slim
entries.summary: $185, deep armholes, generous drape, wool blend with weight. The cardigan that launched a thousand IG saves. Wrong for petite frames; right for everyone who's been saving Pinterest pins of oversized knitwear since 2022.

entries.best_for: If you're under 5'5" or you want a fitted cardigan that doesn't read as boxy
entries.summary: $160, V-neck, true-to-size French cut. Designed for proportions the Bea swallows. The cardigan for restrained, considered, capsule-builder wardrobes.

entries.best_for: If you want classic preppy on a reliable sale cycle
entries.summary: $198 full-price, $90-120 on sale (which happens 4-6 times a year). Classic fit, broadest color range in the price tier. Buy on sale, never at full price.

how_to_pick.pick: The Frankie Shop Bea — the genuine article, not a dupe
Sézane Gaspard — the cardigan designed for actual European proportions
J.Crew Cashmere Crewneck — on sale, in the navy or claret colorway

how_to_pick.if_you_lean: want better cashmere at the same price
how_to_pick.pick: Quince Mongolian Cashmere V-Neck Cardigan ($90) — actual cashmere at the J.Crew sale price

honest_caveats: None of these is the 'best' cardigan in an absolute sense. They're the best for completely different shoppers.
All three pill — that's wool-blend physics. Buy a cashmere comb on day one.
